scientific_boundary.measurement: Provider alternate-pipeline isobaric proteomics abundance values; relative rather than absolute quantities.
scientific_boundary.missing_value_policy: Preserve empty source cells exactly; do not impute, fill, or reinterpret them as zero.
scientific_boundary.allowed_claim: Observed protein coverage and relative abundance patterns across the 30 source-annotated patient-derived glioblastoma models.
scientific_boundary.prohibited_claim: The matrix does not contain intervention response, clinical efficacy, patient outcome, safety, dose, or counterfactual treatment evidence.
